_doc: STYLE_BIBLE de Easy Hero: las reglas visuales que TODA generación reutiliza. Tiene una base común y un estilo por familia (sprites, fondos de combate, mapas), tomados de los prompts del director (taller/prompt_enemy.md, prompt_scene.md, prompt_map.md) y del arte que ya tiene el juego. Cambia aquí y cambia para todo.
name: Easy Hero — fantasía oscura en pixel art

common.lighting: Single warm key light from the upper left, soft cool fill from the right. Same light direction for every asset so they can sit together in one scene.
rules: No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, signatures or watermarks drawn in the image.
No UI, HUD, icons, markers, frames, borders or health bars.
Keep the same art style, outline weight, palette and light direction as the reference images when references are given.

sprite._doc: Personajes, enemigos, NPC, jefes y objetos sueltos (de taller/prompt_enemy.md).
sprite.art_style: Detailed handcrafted 2D dark fantasy RPG pixel art sprite: crisp chunky pixels, strong dark outline, discrete pixel shading, highly detailed equipment and textures. Classic old-school fantasy RPG sprite with a readable silhouette.
sprite.palette: Gritty medieval fantasy aesthetic: muted earthy colors, brown leather and cloth tones, desaturated palette, strong contrast, subtle warm highlights.
sprite.proportions: Semi-realistic proportions (no chibi): humans about 6.5 heads tall; goblins about 4.5 heads, hunched; orcs bulkier and taller than humans. Weapons and gear sized realistically to the body.
sprite.avoid: No anime, no chibi, no cartoon, no smooth digital painting, no 3D render, no gradients.

background._doc: Fondos de combate de lado (de taller/prompt_scene.md).
background.art_style: Cinematic HD-2D fantasy RPG battle scene with strong Octopath Traveler vibes: detailed pixel-art environment blended with realistic 3D depth, miniature diorama aesthetic, layered foreground, midground and background, crisp pixel textures and realistic water, vegetation and terrain.
background.palette: Rich natural fantasy colours with dramatic contrast between light and shadow.
background.lighting_extra: Dramatic cinematic lighting, volumetric god rays, atmospheric fog, bloom, shallow depth of field, tilt-shift effect.
background.avoid: No characters, no enemies, no creatures, no UI, no text, no icons.

map.art_style: Highly detailed handcrafted pixel art, classic fantasy JRPG world map aesthetic, dense environmental detail, crisp pixel clusters, rich textures and strong depth. Atmospheric lighting, subtle fog at distant edges, layered vegetation and architecture integrated naturally into the landscape.
map.avoid: No UI, no icons, no markers, no text, no labels, no grid, no interface elements. Not a collage, not separate scenes.

portrait._doc: Retratos de los diálogos (novela visual). Mismo pixel art que los sprites, pero de frente y más grandes: se ven a media pantalla.
portrait.art_style: Detailed handcrafted 2D dark fantasy RPG pixel art character portrait for a visual novel: crisp pixels, strong dark outline, discrete pixel shading, expressive readable face, highly detailed clothing textures.
portrait.palette: Gritty medieval fantasy aesthetic: muted earthy colors, brown leather and cloth tones, desaturated palette, strong contrast, subtle warm highlights.
portrait.proportions: Semi-realistic proportions (no chibi): humans about 6.5 heads tall; goblins about 4.5 heads, hunched; orcs bulkier and taller than humans. Weapons and gear sized realistically to the body.
portrait.avoid: No anime, no chibi, no cartoon, no smooth digital painting, no 3D render, no gradients, no speech bubbles.

perspective.sprite: Strict side view (profile), camera at the character's chest height, no foreshortening, no three-quarter angle.
perspective.object: Elevated top-down 3/4 view, the same angle as the world map.
perspective.background: Side-view composition (side-scrolling stage): a walkable ground band across the lower third where the fighters stand, depth layers behind.
perspective.map: Elevated isometric / top-down perspective of the whole region, consistent across the entire map.
perspective.portrait: Front view at eye level, slight three-quarter turn, no strong foreshortening.
perspective.gear: Flat front view of the item, like an inventory illustration: no perspective, no foreshortening.

detail_level: Readable silhouette first, detail second: clear shapes at small size, then texture in pixel clusters. No tiny noise that turns to mush when scaled down.

references._doc: Imágenes de referencia de estilo/escala por tipo (rutas desde la raíz). OJO: el modelo tiende a copiar la ORIENTACIÓN de las referencias, así que cada tipo recibe solo referencias que miran hacia donde debe mirar él.
